Recycling morning
Check how to sort recycling with Mr. Sato: plastic bottles, cans, glass bottles and old paper.
Meet neighbourhood head Mr. Sato again
Learn the recycling sorting rules
Good morning. You came just as we agreed. Today is recycling day.
Good morning. Today is recycling day. Could you help me a little?
How should I throw out this plastic bottle?
Take off the cap and rinse it.
Just throw it out as it is.
You can't throw it out as it is. Take off the cap and rinse it.
Do we have to take the label off too?
Yes, we have to take it off.
No, take it off.
When asked whether something is required, answer with "~ nakereba narimasen". Please say it again.
Cans, glass bottles and old paper go in separate bags. Where does this can go?
In the bag for cans.
In the bag for glass bottles.
That's a can. Not a glass bottle. Please put it in the bag for cans.
Which day can recycling go out?
Wednesday morning.
Every evening.
It's only collected on Wednesday morning. Please say it again.
Perfect. Now we can keep the neighbourhood clean and tidy.
Summary: "~ te kudasai" (please ~), "~ nakereba narimasen" (must ~), "nan youbi desu ka" (which day?). Remember: cans, glass bottles and old paper go in separate bags, collected on Wednesday morning.
